# START.DART V3

START.DART V3 rebuilds EzFlutter as an AI-native Flutter application system for Android and iOS.

## Highlights

- Deterministic CLI for app creation and feature/model scaffolding.
- Focused Flutter primitives for reliable application code.
- Feature-first MVVM starter with three environments and a complete test baseline.
- Universal `AGENTS.md` contract with reusable rules, skills, hooks, and references.
- Provider adapters for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini.
- New contributor governance, security reporting, CI, and release automation.

V3 is intentionally breaking. Existing EzFlutter V2 applications should follow the [migration guide](https://github.com/lucasschimmel/start-dart/blob/main/docs/migration-v2-to-v3.md).
